details: For every finite class, $\mathrm{IC}(\mathcal H)\leq\log_2|\mathcal H|$.
proof: Choose a deterministic proper empirical-risk minimizer with fixed tie-breaking. Its output lies in $\mathcal H$, so $I(S;\mathcal A(S))\leq H(\mathcal A(S))\leq\log_2|\mathcal H|$. This learner is admissible in the infimum defining information complexity; then take the distribution and sample-size supremum.
name: Log Size / Information Complexity
